# FDGA027

> DO always explicitly specify visibility modifiers.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.5 Member Modifiers.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0040
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

Interface members are exempt, as in the .NET libraries.

## Options

```ini
dotnet_style_require_accessibility_modifiers = for_non_interface_members
```

## From the book

```csharp
Right:
    internal class SomeClass
    {
        private object _lockObject;
        ...
    }

Wrong:
    class SomeClass
    {
        object _lockObject;
        ...
    }
```
